combo3.title: Daredevil: Two-Card Triantis Backrow Break
combo3.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and two Set cards. Ophrys Scorpio and Byblisp find Bufolicula and Triantis. Triantis places Predator Counters by choosing, not targeting, so the boss's protection doesn't stop them. Daredevil then Tributes the boss as part of its own summon, which starts no chain, and destroys both Set cards. Drosophyllum Hydra Tributes the second monster. Starting hand: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp. Extra Deck: Predaplant Ambulomelides and Predaplant Daredevil. Watch for Ash Blossom on Scorpio and on the three adds, and for Nibiru once Daredevil, your fifth summon, is on the field. A monster that is unaffected by card effects can't get a Predator Counter at all.

cards.name: Any boss monster your opponent controls
Any second monster your opponent controls

steps.text: Normal Summon Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio was Normal Summoned. Its cost is a monster from your hand.
Send Predaplant Byblisp from your hand to the GY to pay Scorpio's cost.
Scorpio resolves: Special Summon Predaplant Longinephila from your Deck.
Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp was sent to the GY (Chain Link 1). It's an "If" trigger, so it doesn't miss the timing.
Activate effect: Predaplant Longinephila was Special Summoned (Chain Link 2).
Longinephila resolves: add Predaplant Bufolicula from your Deck to your hand. Every "Predaplant" monster is also a "Predap" card.
Byblisp resolves: add Predaplant Triantis from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Predaplant Bufolicula in your left Pendulum Zone (Scale 0).
Activate effect: Predaplant Bufolicula's Pendulum Effect. In your Main Phase it summons a DARK monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material.
Send Predaplant Triantis from your hand to the GY as material.
Send Predaplant Longinephila from your field to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Predaplant Ambulomelides (2 "Predaplant" monsters).
Activate effect: Predaplant Ambulomelides was just summoned (Chain Link 1).

Activate effect: Predaplant Triantis was used as material (Chain Link 2). It resolves first. You control 2 monsters, so choose your opponent's boss and their second monster: each gets a Predator Counter and becomes Level 1. Triantis chooses instead of targeting, so the boss's protection doesn't help it.
Ambulomelides resolves: add Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra from your Deck to your hand.

Activate effect: Predaplant Longinephila in your GY. Banishing it places 1 Predator Counter on a face-up monster: put it on your own Ophrys Scorpio. Daredevil counts monsters with a Predator Counter on both fields, yours included.
Banish Predaplant Longinephila from your GY. Scorpio gets the counter.
Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp in your GY. A monster with a Predator Counter is on the field, so it can Special Summon itself.
Special Summon Predaplant Byblisp from your GY. It's banished if it leaves the field.
Tribute your opponent's boss. It has a Predator Counter, and a Tribute for a summon isn't a card effect: it ignores targeting protection and nothing can chain to it.
Tribute Predaplant Byblisp as the "Predaplant" monster you control. It's banished instead of going to the GY.

Special Summon Predaplant Daredevil from your Extra Deck by its contact fusion: Tribute 1 monster with a Predator Counter and 1 "Predaplant" monster you control. It starts no chain. Nibiru is live after this fifth summon.

Activate effect: Predaplant Daredevil (Quick Effect, Main Phase, Special Summoned this turn). Your opponent's second monster and your Ophrys Scorpio have Predator Counters, so target up to 2 Spells/Traps: both Set cards. They're destroyed; your opponent can still chain any of them that can be activated.
Tribute your opponent's second monster. It still has a Predator Counter.
Special Summon Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra from your hand by Tributing that monster. This is Hydra's own summon (once per turn), so it doesn't start a chain either.
Battle Phase: your opponent has no monsters and no Set cards left. Attack directly with Daredevil (2200), Ophrys Scorpio (1200), Ambulomelides (1000) and Hydra (800) for 5200.

combo4.title: Daredevil: Predaplanning Ambush With Super Polymerization
combo4.description: Your opponent's turn. From turn 1 you kept Predaplant Dragostapelia and Predaplant Longinephila on the field, with Predaplanning and Super Polymerization Set and 1 card in hand. Your opponent summons a boss and a second monster and Sets two cards. In their Main Phase, Predaplanning puts a Predator Counter on every face-up monster, and Dragostapelia now negates the activated effects of both of theirs. Super Polymerization turns their boss and Longinephila into Daredevil, and neither player can respond to it. Predaplanning's GY effect and Daredevil's Quick Effect then clear the other three cards on their own turn. Daredevil's effect needs a Main Phase, so don't wait for the Battle Phase to activate Super Polymerization.

cards.name: Any boss monster your opponent controls
Any second monster your opponent controls

steps.text: Your opponent's Main Phase, after they summon their boss and a second monster and Set two cards. Activate your Set Predaplanning.
Send Predaplant Byblisp from your Deck to the GY to pay Predaplanning's cost.

Predaplanning resolves: every face-up monster on the field gets a Predator Counter, yours included, and each one of Level 2 or higher becomes Level 1. Dragostapelia now negates the activated effects of your opponent's monsters with a counter. Predaplanning goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp was sent to the GY.
Byblisp resolves: add Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio from your Deck to your hand for your next turn.
Still in their Main Phase, activate your Set Super Polymerization. Neither player can activate anything in response.
Discard 1 card to pay Super Polymerization's cost.
Send Predaplant Longinephila from your field to the GY as the "Predaplant" material.
Send your opponent's boss to their GY as the Level 1 material. The Predator Counter made it Level 1, and Super Polymerization doesn't target.
Fusion Summon Predaplant Daredevil.
Super Polymerization goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Predaplanning in your GY (Chain Link 1). You just summoned a DARK monster with Super Polymerization, so banish it and target 1 card on the field: your opponent's second monster.
Banish Predaplanning from your GY.

Activate effect: Predaplant Daredevil (Quick Effect) in their Main Phase, as Chain Link 2. It was Special Summoned this turn. Their second monster and your Dragostapelia have Predator Counters, so target both of their Set cards. The count is checked now, before Predaplanning destroys that monster.
Chain Link 2 resolves: Daredevil destroys both Set cards. Chain Link 1 resolves: Predaplanning destroys your opponent's second monster.
Their field is empty during their own Main Phase. You keep Dragostapelia and Daredevil, and Ophrys Scorpio is in your hand for your turn.

combo5.title: Daredevil: Branded Lubellion Break
combo5.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and Set cards. Longinephila is the DARK material for Branded Fusion's Lubellion the Searing Dragon, and Lubellion becomes Mirrorjade. Longinephila's GY effect puts a Predator Counter on the boss without targeting, and Daredevil Tributes it. Mirrorjade banishes the second monster, and the Albion it sends to the GY Sets Branded Banishment in the End Phase. Lubellion and Albion can summon Daredevil (Level 8 or lower), but Branded Banishment and Branded in Red can't (Level 8 or higher). Starting hand: Predaplant Longinephila + Branded Fusion (Limited). Nibiru is live after your fifth summon.

Any second monster your opponent controls

Longinephila resolves: add Predaplant Byblisp from your Deck to your hand.

Send Predaplant Longinephila from your field to the GY as the DARK material.
Fusion Summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon (1 DARK monster + Fallen of Albaz).

Discard Predaplant Byblisp to pay Lubellion's cost.
Lubellion resolves: shuffle Fallen of Albaz from your GY into the Deck as material.
Return Lubellion itself to the Extra Deck as the second material.

Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp was discarded to the GY.
Byblisp resolves: add Predaplant Heliamphorhynchus from your Deck to your hand.

Activate effect: Predaplant Longinephila in your GY. Banishing it places 1 Predator Counter on your opponent's boss. It doesn't target, so "cannot be targeted" doesn't stop it, and the boss becomes Level 1.
Banish Predaplant Longinephila from your GY.
Activate effect: Predaplant Heliamphorhynchus in your hand. Your opponent controls a monster with a Predator Counter.
Special Summon Predaplant Heliamphorhynchus from your hand.
Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp in your GY. A monster with a Predator Counter is on the field.
Special Summon Predaplant Byblisp from your GY. It's banished if it leaves the field. Nibiru is live after this fifth summon.
Tribute your opponent's boss. It has a Predator Counter, and a Tribute for a summon ignores targeting protection and starts no chain.
Tribute Predaplant Byblisp as the "Predaplant" monster you control. It's banished instead of going to the GY.
Special Summon Predaplant Daredevil from your Extra Deck by its contact fusion: Tribute 1 monster with a Predator Counter and 1 "Predaplant" monster you control.
Activate effect: Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon (Quick Effect). It banishes 1 monster on the field without targeting.
Send Albion the Branded Dragon from your Extra Deck to the GY to pay Mirrorjade's cost.
Mirrorjade resolves: banish your opponent's second monster.

Battle Phase: attack directly with Mirrorjade (3000), Daredevil (2200) and Heliamphorhynchus (1200) for 6400. No monster has a Predator Counter any more, so Daredevil's own effect has nothing to count this turn.
End Phase. Activate effect: Albion the Branded Dragon was sent to the GY this turn.

Albion resolves: Set Branded Banishment from your Deck. On your opponent's turn it can revive Mirrorjade or Albion and summon a Level 8 or higher monster from your Extra Deck. It can't summon Daredevil, which is Level 6.

combo6.title: Thorns of Violet Poison: Two-Card Scorpio OTK
combo6.description: Going second into monsters your opponent Special Summoned. Rebuilt from the official card text: Thorns of Violet Poison can only target a monster named "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon", so the line ends on the original dragon, not a retrain. It uses a single Normal Summon and costs 2000 LP for Ultra Polymerization. Starting hand: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp (any monster works as Scorpio's cost). Watch for Ash Blossom on Scorpio and the four adds, and for Nibiru once Scorpio and Cobra return, your fifth summon.

Any second monster your opponent controls

steps.text: Normal Summon Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio. It's your only Normal Summon this turn.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio was Normal Summoned. Its cost is a monster from your hand.
Send Predaplant Byblisp from your hand to the GY to pay Scorpio's cost.

Byblisp resolves: add Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Ultra Polymerization and pay 2000 LP. Neither player can respond to it.

Ambulomelides resolves: add Thorns of Violet Poison from your Deck to your hand. It's always treated as a "Predap" card.
Activate effect: Ultra Polymerization in your GY, targeting Ambulomelides, which it summoned.
Banish Ultra Polymerization from your GY.
Special Summon Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio from your GY. It has 0 ATK and DEF and its effects are negated.
Special Summon Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra from your GY the same way.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ambulomelides, targeting Cobra.
Tribute Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra.
Ambulomelides resolves: Special Summon Predaplant Longinephila from your Deck.
Activate effect: Predaplant Longinephila was Special Summoned.
Longinephila resolves: add Predaplant Bufolicula from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Predaplant Bufolicula in your left Pendulum Zone (Scale 0).
Activate effect: Predaplant Bufolicula's Pendulum Effect. It summons a DARK monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material.
Send Predaplant Ambulomelides from your field to the GY as material (a DARK monster on the field).
Send Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio from your field to the GY as material (the second DARK monster).
Fusion Summon Starving Venom Fusion Dragon (2 DARK monsters on the field). It's the only monster Thorns can target.
Activate effect: your Starving Venom dragon was just summoned. It gains ATK equal to your opponent's boss until the end of the turn, so it now has 2800 plus the boss's ATK.
Activate Thorns of Violet Poison from your hand, targeting your Starving Venom dragon in your Monster Zone. That dragon can't attack this turn.
Thorns resolves: destroy your opponent's boss. It has less ATK than your dragon now.
Destroy their second monster as well; every monster they control with less ATK goes.
Discard your entire hand: Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra.
Your opponent takes damage equal to the destroyed monsters' combined original ATK, even if their current ATK was lower. Thorns of Violet Poison goes to the GY.
Battle Phase: the dragon can't attack this turn, but if your opponent survived the burn, Longinephila (600) attacks directly.
